Method of Attack: PHP object injection vulnerability allowing attackers to cause a vulnerable website to fetch a remote PHP backdoor file and save it to a location of their choice
Exploit code packaged inside an HTTP POST request sent to the victim site
No authentication required to trigger the exploit
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using the Appointments plugin
WordPress sites using the Flickr Gallery plugin
WordPress sites using the RegistrationMagic-Custom Registration Forms plugin
Attack Vector: HTTP POST request to admin-ajax.php for Appointments and RegistrationMagic-Custom Registration Forms plugins
HTTP POST request to the site's root URL for Flickr Gallery plugin
Indicators of Compromise: Evidence of past exploitation found in hacked sites investigated by Wordfence
